decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment remains a credible adjacent use of the firm's crewing and maritime talent network, though it is more niche and less central than core commercial ship-management services.
The maritime education programme fits the firm's training-centre capabilities and seafarer pipeline strategy, and the early expansion to six partner institutions is a positive sign of traction.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are highly aligned with client needs, regulation-driven demand and the firm's push into integrated maritime solutions, with successful delivery already demonstrated.
The emissions compliance dashboard supports the firm's digitalisation and transparency strategy and is strengthened by integration into its existing PAL ship management software.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool matches growing customer demand for FuelEU planning and cost control, although it is still new and could later be absorbed into a broader digital offering rather than withdrawn outright.
